items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Little Luba Prima, Leon Prima, a little Femulara. He was working in the theater. He'd come up there and play after.

ctx.x: Which Mike Lala are you talking about? The one they call Black Mike? Black Mike's my son. White Mike is your son? Yeah. My son, yeah. He plays a lot of trumpet.

And I had them all. I never touched a trumpet for two weeks. They always come up. Little Luba Prima, Leon Prima, a little Femulara. He was working in the theater. He'd come up there and play after. All I had, they made a carnet player line up by the minimums up there.
Even in those days, they had to go jam. They all had to come over with my beat and get jamming.
